target.requirement: Issue #133 M2c step 2: applicable natural context exists before the first screen.

selection_rule: Select exactly by world_revision_id + g4_ref.id + g4_ref.version; verify exact_scene_features refs; no family fallback or dynamic predicate. One profile per exact G4@1.

scene_template_selection.applicability: one modal materialization template is used to honor the active single_candidate rule

surface.limits: Template substrate class only; no parcel-level soil claim.

relief.limits: Broad terrain class only; no exact elevation or geometry.

water_body.limits: Broad water class only; no local depth, flow rate, level, potability, safety, or exact seasonal condition.

bank_structure.limits: Generic margin only; no landing, footing, stability, or access assertion.

tree_layer.limits: Broad vegetation structure; no local species, abundance, stand, or harvestability claim.

shrub_layer.limits: Broad stratum only; no local species or resource stock.

ground_cover.limits: Broad groundcover category inferred from the selected landscape template vegetation and substrate; no species, local abundance, or harvestability claim.

riparian_vegetation.limits: Generic cover category only; no local reed, sedge, shrub, or tree species claim.

natural_materials.limits: Ordinary material categories inferred from the landscape template and exact G4/G5 form; no countable stock, resource node, or right to gather.

seasonal_state.limits: Typical profile only; current frost, ice, flood, and weather states are not asserted.

light.limits: Scene exposure and current time only; no exact visibility or sun angle.

weather.limits: Candidate does not invent a current weather event.

audible_context.limits: Ordinary ambient categories only; no wildlife taxon or human activity assertion.

natural_profile.limits: General ordinary natural context based on authored G4 family and draft regional/seed templates. No place-specific historical fact, local taxon, exact measurement, stock, access, or safety claim.
